purpose: Physically demonstrate that changing the queried scalar cannot alter student-visible non-q evidence or teacher target determination.

population.source: reader-fit/TRAIN-authorised substrate only; no DEV/SEALED/protected outcomes
population.sample: 4096 deterministic hash-selected cell-query pairs spanning donors/operators and nonzero/zero q counts
population.sample_rule: freeze cell/query identities by canonical address and cell identity before intervention values are computed

interventions: set queried raw count to zero
replace queried raw count with deterministic large perturbation max(original+100,7*original+1)

physical_checks.student_token: queried scalar token absent in both baseline and intervention
physical_checks.student_preprocessing: all student-visible non-q tensors and normalization denominators must be bit-identical between baseline and each q intervention for the selected approved path
physical_checks.teacher_target: teacher target construction must be deterministic eval-mode and bit-identical between baseline and q interventions
physical_checks.query_identity: canonical query identity remains supplied and unchanged
physical_checks.hidden_scalar_objective: no hidden-gene scalar target/readout may enter the JEPA objective

pass_rule: Every tested cell-query-intervention triple passes every physical check; zero tolerated leakage events.
failure_rule: Any changed student-visible non-q tensor, denominator, or teacher target is STOP_Q_SAFETY_FAILED. Do not average leakage away.
emits: QSafetyAuthorityV1 instance only after executed PASS
